brief: Comfort socks and tees where every purchase donates an item to someone experiencing homelessness. Average order $65. Great for gifting and for families buying multi-packs.

config.advertiser_summary: A DTC apparel brand selling comfort socks and tees with a 1-for-1 donation model supporting individuals experiencing homelessness. The brand has an average order value of $65 and targets families and gift-buyers.

assumptions: Margin not given; assumed 60% (typical for apparel) for the break-even estimate only.
Break-even per customer (guidance, not enforced): $65 x 60% x 1.1 orders = $42.90.

pricing.rationale: Pay per click: verifiable without trusting a pixel. Maximise conversions within the budget: bids move between $0.25 and the $1.80 cap (category default) to spend it well; no CPA target is invented. Guidance: at the assumed margin, a click is worth about $0.86; bidding above that loses money per customer. Set a target CPA or a lower max CPC to enforce it.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.
